svg.title: Stack, API and what is next. Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui, mobile first with bottom navigation. Backend: Python 3, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy and SQLite, auto seeded on first run. LLM: OpenRouter API with DeepSeek V3. Testing: Pytest with httpx mocking. Deployment: Vercel for the frontend and Render for the backend. Endpoints: GET / health check, GET /products/ lists all products with review counts, POST /recommendations/ returns picks for a cart. Run: in backend, pip install the requirements and run uvicorn app.main:app with reload on port 8000; in the frontend folder, npm install and npm run dev on port 3000. Future improvements: PostgreSQL for production, user accounts and personalised picks, order history and reorder, real inventory data, A/B testing of recommendation quality, Redis caching for LLM responses, WebSocket cart sync, and an analytics dashboard.
